name: Zul'Farrak: both kinds of Shallow Grave despawn after they are opened
contract: Issue #4338: opening a Shallow Grave in Zul'Farrak summons its zombies (10247). #9104 made Shallow Grave 128403
despawn after it is opened; Shallow Grave 128308 had a despawn row without a target and stayed, so it could be
opened again and again. It now despawns one minute after it is opened, which leaves time to take its loot. The
graves in Zul'Farrak lie close together, so the test summons one on its own.

steps.label: CONTROL: a Shallow Grave 128308 lies at the digger's feet
The opened grave stays while its loot can be taken
The opened Shallow Grave 128308 despawns within a minute
